raw.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance Department
The Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance team supports procurement, source-to-pay processes, supply chain performance, supplier management, working capital visibility, and enterprise decision-making. The team partners closely with Finance, Operations, IT/Data, and procurement stakeholders to improve data quality, build trusted analytics, and translate business needs into measurable operational improvements.

Position Overview

This role is based remotely in the United States.

Vantage is seeking a Director, Procurement Intelligence & Predictive Analytics, Global to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of advanced analytics capabilities across Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance. This role will drive enterprise-wide data-driven decision making by transforming complex global data into actionable insights that improve operational performance, optimize working capital, mitigate risk, enhance supplier outcomes, and support executive and strategic business decisions.

The Director will define and execute the global roadmap for procurement analytics, predictive and prescriptive modeling, machine learning, and decision intelligence solutions across Demand-to-Delivery, Source-to-Pay, supplier performance, spend analytics, inventory and asset management, and cash flow forecasting. Working closely with senior leaders across Procurement, Finance and Technology and Business Functions, this role establishes scalable analytics capabilities, data governance standards, and reporting frameworks that enable informed decision-making and deliver measurable business value worldwide.

Essential Job Functions

  • Own and lead the global strategy, roadmap, and governance for procurement analytics, data science, and decision intelligence capabilities that enhance procurement performance, supplier management, sourcing effectiveness, contract compliance, and spend optimization.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Procurement, Finance, Technology and executive leadership by translating complex procurement, supplier, inventory, and supply chain data into actionable insights, business strategies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead the design and deployment of predictive and prescriptive analytics capabilities, leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, forecasting, and decision intelligence to drive enterprise value using both internal and external data sources.

  • Oversee the development and implementation of analytical models supporting demand forecasting, supplier risk management, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time prediction, anomaly detection, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Establish and champion executive dashboards, supplier scorecards, KPI frameworks, and reporting standards that provide visibility into procurement, supply chain, fulfillment, and project performance across the organization.

  • Drive enterprise-wide working capital and cash flow optimization initiatives through advanced analytics of purchasing activity, payment timing, inventory investments, accruals, supplier terms, and capital project spending.

  • Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and business functions to improve forecasting accuracy, scenario planning, capital allocation, operational efficiency, and supplier performance.

  • Lead transformation initiatives across Source-to-Pay processes by identifying strategic opportunities for automation, compliance improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence.

  • Advance procurement analytics capabilities that increase guided buying adoption, spend visibility, purchase order compliance, invoice matching accuracy, goods receipt management, and overall procurement effectiveness.

  • Establish and maintain global procurement data governance standards, including data quality frameworks, master data management, metadata, lineage, controls, and stewardship practices.

  • Drive a culture of data-driven decision making by promoting analytics adoption, enhancing self-service capabilities, and ensuring analytical insights are embedded into business operations and strategic planning.

  • Influence enterprise data and analytics strategy through collaboration with technology and data teams, ensuring scalable solutions, strong governance, and sustainable business impact.

  • Mentor and develop analytics talent while fostering best practices, innovation, and continuous improvement across the analytics organization.

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Supply Chain, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, quantitative strategy, or a related discipline, including experience leading enterprise-scale analytics initiatives.

  • 5+ years of experience supporting or partnering with Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or other enterprise business functions, with demonstrated influence at the leadership level.

  • Proven experience developing and executing analytics strategies, roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable business outcomes and organizational transformation.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and translate complex analytical insights into strategic recommendations, business decisions, and investment priorities.

  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, optimization, and modern cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies.

  • Experience leading the development of enterprise reporting, KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities using Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of procurement operations, strategic sourcing, supplier management, spend analytics, working capital optimization, Demand to Delivery, Source-to-Pay, Asset & Inventory, and supply chain performance management.

  • Familiarity with procurement and ERP platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Workday, Yardi, SAP ERP, or similar enterprise systems.

  • Expertise in data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and enterprise data management best practices.

  • Experience integrating and leveraging procurement, finance, supplier, inventory, contract, project, ERP, and payment data to drive strategic insights and operational improvements.

  • Preferred experience in data center infrastructure, construction, capital projects, procurement analytics, finance analytics, supply chain analytics, or other CAPEX-intensive environments.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, large-scale transformation initiatives, and enterprise data programs in complex, high-growth organizations.

  • Experience building, mentoring, and developing analytics, business intelligence, or data science talent preferred.

  • Professional certifications such as CDMP, CPSM, CIPS, PMP, or related credentials are preferred.

  • Travel up to 20%, with flexibility to increase as business needs evolve.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $180,000-200,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer

raw.description:
What you get to do in this role:

  • Operate as the program-management engine of Marketing's planning system and turn organizational problems into solutions. When a cross-functional gap surfaces (for example, "we can't measure ROI because spend data is unreliable"), you'll run intake, drive root-cause analysis, draft the problem statement, and build a first-cut solution and proposal for leadership review.
  • Run the mechanics of the planning operating rhythm (MOR, QBR, Monthly Forecast, OKR updates). Agendas land ahead of time, pre-reads are tight, decisions get logged, and follow-ups don't drop.
  • Implement scalable processes that help us plan and manage work spanning Strategy, Resources, and Governance. You'll be the forcing function that gets cross-team process work done on schedule, working alongside the functional owners who execute it.
  • Identify connections and reconcile possible collisions across planning inputs, cycles, and cross-functional dependencies with BizOps, GTM Ops, Analytics, and FP&A.
  • Ensure transparency, alignment, and clear communication of planning status, decisions, and cycle milestones across Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • You'll gather the business requirements for our planning data layer (spend data, aggregated investment views, program-to-headcount views), define the end-to-end build plan, and drive it to completion across the owning teams. You own the requirements and the timeline. you are not the builder.
  • Contribute to the development of the strategic planning operations function. Share back the practices, frameworks, and tools that work so the function scales beyond any single cycle.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function.
  • 7+ years of project/program management experience in mid/large size companies, ideally in a marketing, GTM, or operations environment.
  • Drives programs without authority: gets senior, cross-functional stakeholders to commit and hit dates without owning them.
  • Converts ambiguity into structure. Takes a vague "this is broken" and produces a sharp problem statement, options, and a proposal.
  • Business fluency to spec, not to execute: reads a budget and variance view and understands ROI logic well enough to define what analytics and finance need. Does not need to be a finance or analytics expert.
  • Models change-agent behavior by coaching peers to buy in, and by communicating new scalable solutions that improve execution across the organization.
  • Educates cross-functional peers about the planning discipline and advocates for its value.

Partner Growth Engineer

Full-Time | Remote | Canada

Walnut is a leading embedded insurance platform, trusted by partners like BMO, TELUS, Wealthsimple, Viva Finance, and Securian among others.

We're hiring a Partner Growth Engineer to own growth across Walnut's live Partner portfolio — diagnosing performance, building the fix, and shipping it.

The Opportunity

You'll own a named book of the largest, most regulated Partner accounts in North America and carry an expansion number against them. Your primary accountability is growing these accounts: deepening relationships, expanding revenue, and driving performance. You will also bring the technical capability and capacity to build and deploy the tactics that unlock this growth, without waiting for a separate team to do this.

It's a hybrid seat: account leader, growth operator, and technical builder — often in the same week. You must be comfortable and confident in delivering to both the business and engineering stakeholders of Partners.

What You'll Own

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Primary point of contact for a portfolio of named Partner accounts — executive relationship, joint roadmap, QBR cadence, and overall account health

  • Accountability for revenue projections, retention, product and revenue expansion, and Partner and end-user satisfaction

  • Account plans for each Key Growth Account, leveraging Walnut's Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams as needed

Drive Revenue Growth & Expansion

  • Carry an expansion number — NRR, expansion ARR, attachment rate, and conversion lift

  • Own commercial conversations end-to-end: discovery through close, across distribution, carrier, legal, and product stakeholders

Lead Embedded Growth Across the Portfolio

  • Serve as Walnut's internal authority on embedded program growth — the person account leads call when conversion stalls

  • Advise Partners on positioning, channel mix, lifecycle messaging, and in-product placement

  • Jump in and out of accounts outside your direct book to unlock performance

Operate as a Strategic Partner Internally

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Legal, and Compliance at Walnut and Partner companies

  • Bring structured Partner feedback to influence roadmap and product development

  • Build processes, templates, and standards as Walnut's account function scales

Data & Decisions

  • Write SQL against the warehouse; comfortable in DB and BI tools

  • Script reconciliations, reports, and Partner performance benchmarks in Python or Node

Build, Test, and Ship Growth Interventions

  • When required, you will own the build end-to-end; you are comfortable writing the code, shipping the experiment, and reading the result without a handoff

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests across enrollment flows, Partner surfaces, and in-product placements

  • Move fast: diagnose → hypothesize → prototype → test → ship or kill

  • Codify what works into reusable patterns and playbooks across the portfolio

Technical Execution

  • Write production-quality JS/TS, build Vue/React components, instrument funnels. You can deliver when required without needing to escalate or be blocked by a technical issue

  • Design UX changes to enrollment flows and conversion paths — prototype before the meeting

  • Debug webhooks, trace requests through Partner stacks, rewire integrations

Operate as a Strategic Partner Internally

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Legal, and Compliance at Walnut and Partner companies

  • Bring structured Partner feedback to influence roadmap and product development

  • Build processes, templates, and standards as Walnut's account function scales

How You'll Work

  • Fully remote, Canada-based, with travel for Partner meetings and industry events

  • AI-native: use AI tools for your own productivity and build AI solutions to scale impact across the org

What We're Looking For

Core Experience

  • 5+ years carrying a number in a quota-bearing AE, strategic account, or partner-led role at a SaaS, platform, or distribution business

  • Track record growing active enterprise accounts — you can name the partner, the outcome, and what you did

  • Experience selling into lenders, financial institutions, fintechs, telecoms, or platform retailers

  • Partner management experience with enterprise-scale, regulated organizations — navigating procurement, compliance, and security review

  • A secondary Engineering background with fluency with the modern web stack. You can self-diagnose and solve an issue, and you can build the solution if needed

Key Strengths

  • Commercial and ownership-driven — thinks like a GM of their account portfolio

  • Executive presence — comfortable with a CRO or CMO one moment, a VP Engineering the next

  • Strong design taste — can design or direct better enrollment flows and landing pages, and ideally build them

  • Data-driven and disciplined across forecasting, pipeline, and growth measurement

  • AI-native operator across sales, growth, and engineering workflows - you can demonstrate how you have used AI to improve throughput and delivery, connected to the core responsibilities of the role

  • Diagnostic mindset — walks into any live Partner program, quickly defines the ceiling and fastest path to it

  • Bias to ship — builds the test, not the spec; measures everything; ships multiple times per sprint

Nice to Have

  • Embedded insurance, embedded lending, or embedded financial products experience

  • Existing network in US or Canadian lending, fintech, telecom, or financial services

  • Marketing automation or CDP fluency (, Iterable, Braze, HubSpot)

  • Familiarity with our stack: Node.js/TypeScript, Vue 3, AWS, Terraform, CircleCI

  • Startup, founder, zero-to-one, or solo-builder experience

Why Join Walnut

  • Own the growth and performance of Walnut's most important Partner accounts

  • Operate as a hybrid sales, growth, and technical leader with real autonomy

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful upside tied to performance and equity

Note: Candidates must be based in Canada for this role.

Job Description:

Providing for loved ones, planning rewarding retirements, saving enough for whatever lies ahead – our policyholders count on us to be there when it matters most. It’s a big ask, but it’s one that we have the power to deliver when we work together. We collaborate and innovate – pushing one another to transform not just Pacific Life, but the entire industry for the better. Why? Because it’s the right thing to do. Pacific Life is more than a job, it’s a career with purpose. It’s a career where you have the support, balance, and resources to make a positive impact on the future – including your own.

We're actively seeking a talented PFML-Absence Management Claims Consultant to join our Workforce Benefits Division. As a PFML Absence Management Claims Consultant, you'll play a key role in building and delivering a best-in-class Paid Family and Medical Leave claims experience. This role will serve as a PFML subject matter expert and will be responsible for helping design and build the future-state PFML claims operation. The PFML Claims Consultant will partner closely with Product, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and Operations teams to define business requirements, support system configuration and testing, develop workflows, create claims procedures and training materials, drive process improvements, and ensure regulatory requirements are effectively translated into scalable operational solutions. This individual will help build the foundation for PFML claims administration while delivering an empathetic, compliant, and customer-centered experience for employees and employers.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise, regulatory knowledge, critical thinking, and compassion while helping customers navigate important life events.

How you'll help move us forward:

  • Serve as a key business partner in the design, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of Pacific Life's Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) capabilities.

  • Partner closely with Product Owners, Business Analysts, Technology teams, and external vendors to define business requirements, user stories, workflows, business rules, and system functionality needed to support PFML administration.

  • Act as the PFML claims subject matter expert (SME) throughout the product development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, solution design, testing, implementation, and production support.

  • Help design and build the end-to-end PFML claims experience, ensuring processes are scalable, compliant, efficient, and customer focused.

  • Develop and maintain claims procedures, workflows, job aids, training materials, and operational documentation aligned with state regulations, product design, and system capabilities.

  • Participate in system configuration reviews, user acceptance testing (UAT), workflow validation, defect identification, and implementation of new PFML products and enhancements.

  • Serve as a SME and monitor evolving state PFML legislation and regulatory requirements and translate business and compliance requirements into operational processes and system functionality.

  • Consult on industry best practices and recommend innovative solutions to improve the customer experience, claims outcomes, operational efficiency, and automation opportunities.

  • Partner closely with Legal, Compliance, Employer Services, Customer Service, Operations, Product, and Technology teams to ensure compliant and effective administration of PFML programs.

  • Administer and adjudicate Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML) claims from intake through resolution, ensuring timely, accurate, and compliant claim decisions.

  • Interpret state-specific eligibility requirements, benefit calculations, waiting periods, leave durations, and documentation requirements.

  • Effectively communicate claim decisions, requirements, next steps, and benefit information to claimants, employers, brokers, and internal partners.

  • Demonstrate an empathetic and customer-centric mindset while assisting employees during significant family, medical, and caregiving events.

  • Identify opportunities to improve customer experience, operational efficiency, quality, and compliance within the claims organization.

  • Assist with onboarding, training, mentoring, and development of team members.

  • Participate in audits, quality reviews, special projects, process reviews, and departmental initiatives.

  • Support and promote change management, innovation, and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Demonstrate sound judgment and discretion regarding confidential and sensitive information.

The experience you bring:

  • College degree or equivalent work experience preferred.

  • 5+ years of experience in Paid Family and Medical Leave (PFML), disability claims, leave management, absence management, insurance claims, or a related field.

  • Strong knowledge of state PFML programs, leave laws, regulatory requirements, and employer-sponsored leave and disability products.

  • Experience interpreting statutes, regulations, policy provisions, administrative guidelines, and complex business requirements.

  • Demonstrated ability to make fair, balanced, and objective decisions with a high degree of integrity and professionalism.

  • Strong analytical, investigative, problem-solving, and critical-thinking skills.

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively communicate with customers, employers, brokers, and internal partners.

  • Customer-focused with a compassionate and empathetic approach to helping employees navigate significant life events.

  • Strong organizational and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams, including Product, Technology, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Customer Service.

  • Experience supporting process improvement initiatives, workflow design, procedure development, training, quality assurance, testing, or system implementation activities.

  • Detail-oriented with the ability to learn and become proficient in claims administration systems, workflow tools, reporting platforms, and related technologies.

What makes you stand out:

  • Insurance designations, industry certifications, and experience with FMLA, ADA, Disability, or integrated absence management programs are preferred.

raw.description:
About EarnIn

As one of the first pioneers of earned wage access, our passion at EarnIn is building products that deliver real-time financial flexibility for those with the unique needs of living paycheck to paycheck. Our community members access their earnings as they earn them, with options to spend, save, and grow their money without mandatory fees, interest rates, or credit checks.

We’re fortunate to have an incredibly experienced leadership team, combined with world-class funding partners like A16Z, Matrix Partners, DST, Ribbit Capital, and a very healthy core business with a tremendous runway. We’re growing fast and are excited to continue bringing world-class talent onboard to help shape the next chapter of our growth journey.

POSITION SUMMARY

We are the Platform-as-a-Service Engineering team at EarnIn. We don’t just manage infrastructure; we build the foundational "Paved Road" that enables our product teams to ship with velocity and safety. Our stack is built on AWS, EKS, and Argo CD, but our future is Agentic. We are shifting from manual configuration to AI-augmented orchestration, in which the platform anticipates developers' needs and self-heals through intelligent automation. We're seeking a Platform Engineer (I3) who is an AI-native builder, someone who doesn't just use AI tools but designs and deploys AI agents to eliminate toil, accelerate developer workflows, and multiply what a lean team can deliver. You will own solutions across Kubernetes (AWS EKS), GitOps (Argo CD), CI/CD (GitHub Actions), and our developer portal (Cortex), while relentlessly automating repetitive operational work through agentic AI.

As an I3 engineer, you are a professional contributor who effectively represents the team's perspective and communicates across functions. You will collaborate with DevX, SRE, and Product Engineering peers to turn fragmented workflows into AI-powered golden paths, building agents that handle incident triage, environment provisioning, config generation, and developer self-service, so engineers can focus on high-value work rather than tickets, aligned with our Platform Engineer growth matrix.

This is a remote position, though it could also be a hybrid role from our Mexico City office as part of our expanding site. EarnIn offers excellent benefits for our employees, including healthcare, internet and cell phone reimbursement, a learning and development stipend, and potential opportunities to travel to our Mountain View headquarters. Our salary ranges are determined by role, level, and location. We are unable to provide visa sponsorship or immigration support for this position.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • AI-Agent Development: Design, build, and iterate on AI agents that automate platform operations, from service and infra bootstrap, intelligent incident diagnosis, automated runbook execution, to self-healing infrastructure and PR-review bots. Own the agent lifecycle: prompt engineering, tool/function-call orchestration, evaluation, and production monitoring.
  • Workflow Automation with AI: Identify and eliminate repetitive human-in-the-loop workflows across CI/CD, environment management, access provisioning, and change management.
  • Kubernetes Infrastructure: Support our Kubernetes platform on AWS EKS, with a focus on environment hygiene and security; execute cluster-level tasks and updates with minimal support, and leverage AI for anomaly detection, capacity recommendations, and automated remediation.
  • Developer Experience: Utilize our developer control plane (Cortex) to maintain paved paths and self-service actions, helping teams move from idea to production with minimal friction.
  • Observability & Excellence: Strengthen operational excellence by monitoring SLOs/error budgets and utilizing Datadog for metrics, traces, and logs to improve system reliability.
  • Platform Development: Develop platform services using industry best practices that enable operational excellence for Data, CI/CD, and Security.
  • Service Standardization: Maintain service scaffolds and templates that encode testing and telemetry standards, ensure alignment with platform baselines, and use AI to auto-generate and validate configurations against them.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 3+ years in platform, infrastructure, or backend engineering with deep knowledge of Kubernetes (EKS) and cloud-native architectures on AWS.
  • Demonstrated experience building AI agents or agentic workflows, not just using Copilot or ChatGPT, but designing multi-step AI systems that autonomously perform operational tasks (e.g., LLM-powered runbook agents, intelligent CI/CD bots, self-service assistants with tool-use/function-calling).
  • Track record of automating away repetitive workflows with AI. You should be able to point to specific examples in which you replaced manual processes with AI-driven automation, enabling a team to do more with fewer resources.
  • Experience in GitOps (Argo CD) and CI (GitHub Actions) for multi-service systems.
  • Strong coding skills in Go and/or Python, treating infrastructure as software.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to clearly convey technical issues and advocate for both the team's and the customer's needs.
  • Experience with LLM orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, or custom agent architectures) and prompt engineering for production systems.
  • Mission-Driven: A strong advocate for the customer who takes initiative to fix issues and constantly asks, "Can an AI agent do this instead of a human?"
  • Experience with service mesh (e.g., Linkerd) and traffic management patterns is a plus.
  • Hands-on contributions to developer productivity insights and observability for cost-aware engineering decisions are a plus.
A Note on AI in the Hiring Process: EarnIn may use Artificial Intelligence (AI)-powered tools during the hiring process, including tools that generate summaries or notes for interviewers, review resumes, assist with scheduling, or help identify themes across candidate responses and profiles for a given role. Final hiring decisions are made by human interviewers and hiring managers. If you have any concerns about the use of AI in our hiring process, please connect with your recruiter. With your consent, EarnIn may use AI tools to help transcribe or summarize interviews. Recordings are treated as confidential candidate data and are accessible only to authorized hiring personnel. Declining to be recorded will not negatively affect your candidacy or evaluation.

At EarnIn, we believe that the best way to build a financial system that works for everyday people is by hiring a team that represents our diverse community. Our team is diverse not only in background and experience but also in perspective. We celebrate our diversity and strive to create a culture of belonging. EarnIn does not unlawfully discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related medical conditions), gender identity, gender expression, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, registered domestic partner status, sexual orientation, genetic information, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws. EarnIn is an E-Verify participant.

EarnIn does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or HR team.

raw.excerpt: Who are GridBeyond? GridBeyond is a dynamic and rapidly growing green tech energy company, committed to delivering innovative solutions that accelerate the global transition to net zero.
raw.description:
Who are GridBeyond?

GridBeyond is a dynamic and rapidly growing green tech energy company, committed to delivering innovative solutions that accelerate the global transition to net zero. We harness cutting-edge AI to optimise energy assets, from commercial and industrial demand response through to utility-scale battery storage, renewable generation, and distributed energy resources.

With operations across Ireland, the UK, the US, Japan, Australia and other international markets, GridBeyond is proud to support customers and partners in maximising value from renewable energy generation, demand flexibility and storage, while contributing to a greener, cleaner world.

What’s this role about?

As MISO Market Manager – US Market Strategy & Regulatory, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing GridBeyond’s market strategy. This role will focus on identifying commercial market opportunities, supporting regulatory compliance, enabling market access, and driving revenue growth for GridBeyond’s energy products and services.

You will work closely with sales, operations, product, trading, and leadership teams to ensure GridBeyond is well positioned to participate successfully across US energy markets, including wholesale power markets, ancillary services, demand response, capacity markets, and flexibility services.

This is a key role for someone with strong knowledge of the US energy market landscape, regulatory frameworks, MISO ISO/RTO market structures, and the commercial drivers behind battery storage, renewables, demand response and distributed energy resources.

What will I be doing?

Market Strategy Development

  • Develop and execute market strategies that align GridBeyond’s commercial objectives with US regulatory frameworks and market opportunities
  • Conduct comprehensive market analysis to identify trends, opportunities, risks, and threats across US power markets, including wholesale markets, ancillary services, capacity markets, demand response and other flexibility service
  • Monitor competitor activity, market design changes, policy developments and industry trends to ensure GridBeyond remains ahead of market changes
  • Translate complex market and regulatory data into clear, actionable strategies that support revenue growth and market expansion

Regulatory & Market Compliance

  • Stay abreast of regulatory changes, guidelines and standards affecting the US energy industry, with a MISO focus on demand response, ancillary services, battery storage, capacity markets and distributed energy resources
  • Monitor and assess developments from relevant US regulatory bodies, ISOs/RTOs, industry associations and market stakeholders.
  • Support the identification and management of market regulatory risks in line with GridBeyond’s commercial strategy and risk appetite
  • Maintain a strong understanding of market rules and regulatory obligations to support GridBeyond’s participation in US energy markets

Market Participation & Commercial Enablement

  • Support GridBeyond’s registration, qualification and participation in relevant US electricity markets, including demand response, ancillary services, capacity and flexibility programmes.
  • Work closely with sales, marketing, product and operations teams to support customer engagement, commercial proposals and market-entry initiatives
  • Provide market insight and strategic guidance to help sales teams position GridBeyond’s products and services effectively with customers and partner
  • Support the development of scalable routes to market for battery energy storage, renewable assets, demand response and distributed energy resources.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with key market stakeholders, including regulatory agencies, ISO/RTO representatives, industry associations, customers, partners and market participants.
  • Represent GridBeyond in industry forums, conferences, stakeholder meetings and working groups to enhance the company’s visibility and influence in the US energy sector.
  • Engage with strategic customers and partners in support of business development and market expansion

Market Intelligence & Reporting

  • Produce market updates, insights, briefings and recommendations for internal stakeholders and leadership teams
  • Establish and monitor key performance indicators related to market strategy, commercial opportunity, regulatory readiness and revenue growth.
  • Support thought leadership activity by contributing to market insights, industry commentary, customer presentations and external-facing content.

What do I need to be a good technical fit for this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Economics, Energy Management, Engineering, Environmental Science, Finance or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years’ experience in energy market strategy, market operations, regulatory affairs, demand response, battery storage, renewable energy, or related energy sector roles
  • Strong understanding of US energy market structures, regulatory frameworks and commercial drivers impacting revenue growth
  • Experience working with US ISO/RTO markets such as MISO is required.
  • Knowledge of ancillary services, capacity markets, wholesale power markets, demand response, battery energy storage and distributed energy resources.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and implement strategies that support sales, market access and revenue growth in a complex regulatory environment
  • Excellent analytical, strategic thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to turn complex market data into actionable recommendations.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to engage and influence internal teams, customers, partners and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Python, SQL, Power BI, Tableau or other analytical tools would be beneficial.

What success looks like

In this role, you will:

  • Help define and execute GridBeyond’s US market strategy.
  • Identify new revenue opportunities across US energy markets.
  • Support scalable market participation for demand response, battery storage, renewables and distributed energy assets.
  • Act as a key internal expert on US regulatory and market developments.
  • Deliver detailed operational support, including market submissions, compliance filings,
  • Strengthen GridBeyond’s market presence with customers, partners, regulators and industry stakeholders.
  • Enable commercial and operational teams to make informed, market-led decisions.

Why Join GridBeyond?

  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Fully remote US-based role.
  • Opportunity to work at the forefront of clean energy and grid innovation.
  • Fast-growing international technology company.
  • Collaborative and purpose-driven culture.
  • Excellent career progression opportunities.
  • Work alongside experts in energy markets, AI, flexibility services, and battery storage.

Our Values

Customer Obsessed – We put our customers at the centre of every decision.

Relentless – We challenge boundaries and pursue excellence in everything we do.

Integrity – We build trust through honesty, transparency, and accountability.

Agility – We embrace change, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Collaboration – We achieve more by working together.

GridBeyond is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all qualified candidates.

raw.description:
About Vantage Data Centers

Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands.

Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance Department
The Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance team supports procurement, source-to-pay processes, supply chain performance, supplier management, working capital visibility, and enterprise decision-making. The team partners closely with Finance, Operations, IT/Data, and procurement stakeholders to improve data quality, build trusted analytics, and translate business needs into measurable operational improvements.

Position Overview

This role is based remotely in the United States.

Vantage is seeking a Director, Procurement Intelligence & Predictive Analytics, Global to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of advanced analytics capabilities across Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance. This role will drive enterprise-wide data-driven decision making by transforming complex global data into actionable insights that improve operational performance, optimize working capital, mitigate risk, enhance supplier outcomes, and support executive and strategic business decisions.

The Director will define and execute the global roadmap for procurement analytics, predictive and prescriptive modeling, machine learning, and decision intelligence solutions across Demand-to-Delivery, Source-to-Pay, supplier performance, spend analytics, inventory and asset management, and cash flow forecasting. Working closely with senior leaders across Procurement, Finance and Technology and Business Functions, this role establishes scalable analytics capabilities, data governance standards, and reporting frameworks that enable informed decision-making and deliver measurable business value worldwide.

Essential Job Functions

  • Own and lead the global strategy, roadmap, and governance for procurement analytics, data science, and decision intelligence capabilities that enhance procurement performance, supplier management, sourcing effectiveness, contract compliance, and spend optimization.

  • Serve as a strategic advisor to Procurement, Finance, Technology and executive leadership by translating complex procurement, supplier, inventory, and supply chain data into actionable insights, business strategies, and measurable outcomes.

  • Lead the design and deployment of predictive and prescriptive analytics capabilities, leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, forecasting, and decision intelligence to drive enterprise value using both internal and external data sources.

  • Oversee the development and implementation of analytical models supporting demand forecasting, supplier risk management, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time prediction, anomaly detection, and cash flow forecasting.

  • Establish and champion executive dashboards, supplier scorecards, KPI frameworks, and reporting standards that provide visibility into procurement, supply chain, fulfillment, and project performance across the organization.

  • Drive enterprise-wide working capital and cash flow optimization initiatives through advanced analytics of purchasing activity, payment timing, inventory investments, accruals, supplier terms, and capital project spending.

  • Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and business functions to improve forecasting accuracy, scenario planning, capital allocation, operational efficiency, and supplier performance.

  • Lead transformation initiatives across Source-to-Pay processes by identifying strategic opportunities for automation, compliance improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence.

  • Advance procurement analytics capabilities that increase guided buying adoption, spend visibility, purchase order compliance, invoice matching accuracy, goods receipt management, and overall procurement effectiveness.

  • Establish and maintain global procurement data governance standards, including data quality frameworks, master data management, metadata, lineage, controls, and stewardship practices.

  • Drive a culture of data-driven decision making by promoting analytics adoption, enhancing self-service capabilities, and ensuring analytical insights are embedded into business operations and strategic planning.

  • Influence enterprise data and analytics strategy through collaboration with technology and data teams, ensuring scalable solutions, strong governance, and sustainable business impact.

  • Mentor and develop analytics talent while fostering best practices, innovation, and continuous improvement across the analytics organization.

  • Additional duties as assigned by Management.

Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Supply Chain, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred.

  • 10+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, quantitative strategy, or a related discipline, including experience leading enterprise-scale analytics initiatives.

  • 5+ years of experience supporting or partnering with Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or other enterprise business functions, with demonstrated influence at the leadership level.

  • Proven experience developing and executing analytics strategies, roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable business outcomes and organizational transformation.

  • Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and translate complex analytical insights into strategic recommendations, business decisions, and investment priorities.

  • Deep expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, optimization, and modern cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies.

  • Experience leading the development of enterprise reporting, KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities using Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies.

  • Strong understanding of procurement operations, strategic sourcing, supplier management, spend analytics, working capital optimization, Demand to Delivery, Source-to-Pay, Asset & Inventory, and supply chain performance management.

  • Familiarity with procurement and ERP platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Workday, Yardi, SAP ERP, or similar enterprise systems.

  • Expertise in data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and enterprise data management best practices.

  • Experience integrating and leveraging procurement, finance, supplier, inventory, contract, project, ERP, and payment data to drive strategic insights and operational improvements.

  • Preferred experience in data center infrastructure, construction, capital projects, procurement analytics, finance analytics, supply chain analytics, or other CAPEX-intensive environments.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, large-scale transformation initiatives, and enterprise data programs in complex, high-growth organizations.

  • Experience building, mentoring, and developing analytics, business intelligence, or data science talent preferred.

  • Professional certifications such as CDMP, CPSM, CIPS, PMP, or related credentials are preferred.

  • Travel up to 20%, with flexibility to increase as business needs evolve.

Physical Demands and Special Requirements
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds.

Additional Details

  • Salary Range: $180,000-200,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations)

  • This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits.

  • Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown.

We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations.

Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community.

Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values.

Vantage Data Centers is an Equal Opportunity Employer

Vantage Data Centers does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage Data Centers.

raw.description:
What you get to do in this role:

  • Operate as the program-management engine of Marketing's planning system and turn organizational problems into solutions. When a cross-functional gap surfaces (for example, "we can't measure ROI because spend data is unreliable"), you'll run intake, drive root-cause analysis, draft the problem statement, and build a first-cut solution and proposal for leadership review.
  • Run the mechanics of the planning operating rhythm (MOR, QBR, Monthly Forecast, OKR updates). Agendas land ahead of time, pre-reads are tight, decisions get logged, and follow-ups don't drop.
  • Implement scalable processes that help us plan and manage work spanning Strategy, Resources, and Governance. You'll be the forcing function that gets cross-team process work done on schedule, working alongside the functional owners who execute it.
  • Identify connections and reconcile possible collisions across planning inputs, cycles, and cross-functional dependencies with BizOps, GTM Ops, Analytics, and FP&A.
  • Ensure transparency, alignment, and clear communication of planning status, decisions, and cycle milestones across Marketing leadership and cross-functional partners.
  • You'll gather the business requirements for our planning data layer (spend data, aggregated investment views, program-to-headcount views), define the end-to-end build plan, and drive it to completion across the owning teams. You own the requirements and the timeline. you are not the builder.
  • Contribute to the development of the strategic planning operations function. Share back the practices, frameworks, and tools that work so the function scales beyond any single cycle.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience using or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This may include using AI-powered tools, automating workflows, analyzing AI-driven insights, or exploring AI's potential impact on the function.
  • 7+ years of project/program management experience in mid/large size companies, ideally in a marketing, GTM, or operations environment.
  • Drives programs without authority: gets senior, cross-functional stakeholders to commit and hit dates without owning them.
  • Converts ambiguity into structure. Takes a vague "this is broken" and produces a sharp problem statement, options, and a proposal.
  • Business fluency to spec, not to execute: reads a budget and variance view and understands ROI logic well enough to define what analytics and finance need. Does not need to be a finance or analytics expert.
  • Models change-agent behavior by coaching peers to buy in, and by communicating new scalable solutions that improve execution across the organization.
  • Educates cross-functional peers about the planning discipline and advocates for its value.

For positions in this location, we offer a base pay of $126,800 - $221,900, plus equity (when applicable), variable/incentive compensation and benefits. Sales positions generally offer a competitive On Target Earnings (OTE) incentive compensation structure. Please note that the base pay shown is a guideline, and individual total compensation will vary based on factors such as qualifications, skill level, competencies, and work location. We also offer health plans, including flexible spending accounts, a 401(k) Plan with company match, ESPP, matching donations, a flexible time away plan and family leave programs. Compensation is based on the geographic location in which the role is located and is subject to change based on work location.

Partner Growth Engineer

Full-Time | Remote | Canada

Walnut is a leading embedded insurance platform, trusted by partners like BMO, TELUS, Wealthsimple, Viva Finance, and Securian among others.

We're hiring a Partner Growth Engineer to own growth across Walnut's live Partner portfolio — diagnosing performance, building the fix, and shipping it.

The Opportunity

You'll own a named book of the largest, most regulated Partner accounts in North America and carry an expansion number against them. Your primary accountability is growing these accounts: deepening relationships, expanding revenue, and driving performance. You will also bring the technical capability and capacity to build and deploy the tactics that unlock this growth, without waiting for a separate team to do this.

It's a hybrid seat: account leader, growth operator, and technical builder — often in the same week. You must be comfortable and confident in delivering to both the business and engineering stakeholders of Partners.

What You'll Own

Strategic Account Leadership

  • Primary point of contact for a portfolio of named Partner accounts — executive relationship, joint roadmap, QBR cadence, and overall account health

  • Accountability for revenue projections, retention, product and revenue expansion, and Partner and end-user satisfaction

  • Account plans for each Key Growth Account, leveraging Walnut's Product, Engineering, and Implementation teams as needed

Drive Revenue Growth & Expansion

  • Carry an expansion number — NRR, expansion ARR, attachment rate, and conversion lift

  • Own commercial conversations end-to-end: discovery through close, across distribution, carrier, legal, and product stakeholders

Lead Embedded Growth Across the Portfolio

  • Serve as Walnut's internal authority on embedded program growth — the person account leads call when conversion stalls

  • Advise Partners on positioning, channel mix, lifecycle messaging, and in-product placement

  • Jump in and out of accounts outside your direct book to unlock performance

Operate as a Strategic Partner Internally

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Legal, and Compliance at Walnut and Partner companies

  • Bring structured Partner feedback to influence roadmap and product development

  • Build processes, templates, and standards as Walnut's account function scales

Data & Decisions

  • Write SQL against the warehouse; comfortable in DB and BI tools

  • Script reconciliations, reports, and Partner performance benchmarks in Python or Node

Build, Test, and Ship Growth Interventions

  • When required, you will own the build end-to-end; you are comfortable writing the code, shipping the experiment, and reading the result without a handoff

  • Run A/B and multivariate tests across enrollment flows, Partner surfaces, and in-product placements

  • Move fast: diagnose → hypothesize → prototype → test → ship or kill

  • Codify what works into reusable patterns and playbooks across the portfolio

Technical Execution

  • Write production-quality JS/TS, build Vue/React components, instrument funnels. You can deliver when required without needing to escalate or be blocked by a technical issue

  • Design UX changes to enrollment flows and conversion paths — prototype before the meeting

  • Debug webhooks, trace requests through Partner stacks, rewire integrations

Operate as a Strategic Partner Internally

  • Collaborate cross-functionally across Engineering, Product, Legal, and Compliance at Walnut and Partner companies

  • Bring structured Partner feedback to influence roadmap and product development

  • Build processes, templates, and standards as Walnut's account function scales

How You'll Work

  • Fully remote, Canada-based, with travel for Partner meetings and industry events

  • AI-native: use AI tools for your own productivity and build AI solutions to scale impact across the org

What We're Looking For

Core Experience

  • 5+ years carrying a number in a quota-bearing AE, strategic account, or partner-led role at a SaaS, platform, or distribution business

  • Track record growing active enterprise accounts — you can name the partner, the outcome, and what you did

  • Experience selling into lenders, financial institutions, fintechs, telecoms, or platform retailers

  • Partner management experience with enterprise-scale, regulated organizations — navigating procurement, compliance, and security review

  • A secondary Engineering background with fluency with the modern web stack. You can self-diagnose and solve an issue, and you can build the solution if needed

Key Strengths

  • Commercial and ownership-driven — thinks like a GM of their account portfolio

  • Executive presence — comfortable with a CRO or CMO one moment, a VP Engineering the next

  • Strong design taste — can design or direct better enrollment flows and landing pages, and ideally build them

  • Data-driven and disciplined across forecasting, pipeline, and growth measurement

  • AI-native operator across sales, growth, and engineering workflows - you can demonstrate how you have used AI to improve throughput and delivery, connected to the core responsibilities of the role

  • Diagnostic mindset — walks into any live Partner program, quickly defines the ceiling and fastest path to it

  • Bias to ship — builds the test, not the spec; measures everything; ships multiple times per sprint

Nice to Have

  • Embedded insurance, embedded lending, or embedded financial products experience

  • Existing network in US or Canadian lending, fintech, telecom, or financial services

  • Marketing automation or CDP fluency (, Iterable, Braze, HubSpot)

  • Familiarity with our stack: Node.js/TypeScript, Vue 3, AWS, Terraform, CircleCI

  • Startup, founder, zero-to-one, or solo-builder experience

Why Join Walnut

  • Own the growth and performance of Walnut's most important Partner accounts

  • Operate as a hybrid sales, growth, and technical leader with real autonomy

  • Competitive compensation with meaningful upside tied to performance and equity

Note: Candidates must be based in Canada for this role.

raw.description:
At TE, you will unleash your potential working with people from diverse backgrounds and industries to create a safer, sustainable and more connected world.

​

Job Overview

As a member of the Digital Data Networks (DDN) business in TE Connectivity you will play a key role in the design of products for high-speed products in the connector, cable assembly, and/or radio system industry—targeting high-speed communications and connectivity within datacenters and wireless infrastructure.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

The Internal Cables & Connectors Reliability & Testing (R&T) Leader will lead a dedicated team of R&T engineers and will have responsibility for driving standardized Design for Reliability Engineering (DfRE) and Robustness Validation (RV) Methodologies for all Internal Cable & Connectors Products in the DDN Portfolio. He/she and their team will work extremely closely with customers, Product Development Engineering (PDE) teams, Manufacturing Process Development Engineering (MPDE) teams, Field Application Engineering (FAE) and Advanced Quality Engineering (AQE) to deeply understand the end application requirements and the associated “mission profile”. They will partner with the Global R&T COE to drive the application of standardized methodologies and alignment on all Reliability Testing and Test & Validation plans for each of the assigned new product development programs. They will identify unique product line test needs and application testing requirements and work with the R&T COE to develop custom Test System & Software as required to support the unique testing requirements for each product line. In addition, he/she will also partner with the Global R&T COE to co-develop Reliability Test Plans and Test & Validation Plans aligned with TE’s LeanPD stage gate approach for product development.

The Internal Cable & Connectors R&T Leader will oversee integrating reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (“mission profile”) through Product Release into mass production. DfRE Experts in the Global R&T COE will help determine the appropriate test strategy to collect data using destructive Highly Accelerated Life Test (HALT) or Highly Accelerated Stress Tests (HAST) techniques to evaluate product reliability. Based on collected data and in close collaboration with PDE teams, they will identify weak design/process features or components and work closely with PDE and AQE on the development of corrective actions and improvement plans, engaging with material and component experts to evaluate improvements of the corrective actions by technics such a stress/accelerated screening.

Role Responsibilities

ENGINEERS ON INTERNAL CABLE & CONNECTORS R&T TEAM WILL HAVE THE FOLLOWING RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Integrate reliability considerations during technology & product evaluation, NPI product development from receipt of Customer Spec (Mission Profile) through Product Release into mass production.
    • Contribute towards requirement engineering. Understand the load requirements clearly to derive inner load and stresses.
    • Drive reliability planning tailored to environmental and use conditions, integrating contingency planning and business impact.
    • Analysis of test data. knowledge on data acquisition methods and system.
    • Apply accelerated test models and test-to-failure strategies to determine reliability limits and identify failure modes.
    • Perform the initial FIT estimation based on data from standards such as Siemens Norm SN-29500. Calculate final FIT value based on test data.
    • Analyze customer requirements, application requirements and mission profile to determine the optimal validation test to evaluate reliability of DDN products.
    • Design and develop detailed Test & Validation (T&V) Plans for Early Validation Testing (EVT), Design Validation Testing (DVT) and Process Validation Testing (PVT); coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports.
    • Design and develop Packaging Test & Validation Plans; coordinate all Validation Testing internally or externally, publish validation test reports
    • Lead corrective and preventive action (CAPA) processes for reliability issues across products.
    • Contribute to or manage a centralized database of reliability test plans, models, and field data to promote reuse and faster decision-making.
    • Present reliability status and risks to executive leadership, influencing design decisions and investment in robustness.
    • Leverage on accelerated test methods to explore design margins and to enable fast selection of concepts.
    • Provide guidance on sample size requirements and duration for reliability testing by utilizing reliability statistics.
    • Act as a champion for reliability culture, fostering a proactive and metrics-driven mindset within cross-functional teams.
    • Analyze data from those optimal validation tests to calculate reliability and identify risks or failures. Calculate MTTF based on test to failure evaluation.
    • For identified risks, support definition of mitigation plans and implementation to improve reliability.
    • For identified high risk failure modes and actual failures, support definition of corrective actions and their implementation to improve reliability.
    • Communicate and interact with customer reliability experts to report on reliability analysis.
    • Participate in design reviews and facilitate the reliability section of the design review.
    • Establish a database of reliability tests, models to be re-used across projects.

What your background should look like

 Bachelor/ Master’s degree in technical discipline (Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics)
 10+ years of Experience a high-speed hardware engineering role serving telecommunications market or data center applications.
 Seasoned people leader, experience managing engineering teams in global corporate matrixed environment.
 Must also have many years of experience working with test equipment, test systems, test labs, development and deployment of HALT/HAST testing, Test & Validation Plans, development of custom test systems and performing “application tests.” Must have a good balance between theory and practice.
 Experience interacting with global cross-functional engineering teams in multi-site global organization.
 Experience with high-speed test equipment (Digital Sampling Oscilloscope, Vector Network Analyzer, Bit Error Rate Tester, TDR, Pattern Generators, Power Supplies, etc.)
 In depth familiarity with IEEE 802.3: The cornerstone for Ethernet networking. Recent iterations (e.g., 802.3ck) define standards for 100 Gb/s, 200 Gb/s, and 400 Gb/s operation over copper and fiber, as well as Next-Gen (800G/1.6T) data center requirements.
 Expertise with electronic assembly product development and validation of hardware and software.
 Excellent English, both verbal and written, and the ability to interact professionally with customers, leadership, stakeholders, cross functional teams and subject matter experts.
 Exceptional analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills and ability to make decisions when presented with a series of challenges, conflicts and constraints. Ability to drive to big picture goals and milestones while valuing and maintaining strong attention to the details.
 Knowledge on FIT estimation methodology, statistical analysis for reliability calculation such as Weibull-analysis or 2-statistics, application of Bayes theorem, random failure principle, FMEDA, FTA
 Reliability Engineering training from company, ASQ, TUV, Reliasoft or equivalent
 Experience with custom product development, working closely with customers to define mission profile of the end application and optimizing reliability strategy based on customer needs.
 Experience in running statistical analysis for reliability calculation for mechatronic products.
 A high curiosity in understanding how systems/products work along with a reverse engineering mindset.
 Willingness to travel as required, ~20%

WE VALUE -
+ DFSS Blackbelt or DFSS Green Belt Certified
+ Standards Knowledge - ANSI/TIA-942 Standard, ANSI/TIA-568-E Standard, ISO/IEC 11801 Standard, ISO/IEC 24764 Standard, EIA-364 1000B, IPC Standards for Interconnecting and Packaging Electronic Assemblies, UL Standards for Data Center Component Level Certifications (i.e. UL 1977, UL 444, UL 817, UL 2416).
+ Knowledge in data center architecture, connectors, sockets, wire harnesses, High-Speed connectivity products, electronics, measurement & signal processing.
+ Experience in product development for data center applications
+ Experience in product development, test & validation of connectors & sockets, High-Speed interconnect solutions.

#NATAUV

Competencies

SET : Strategy, Execution, Talent (for managers)

ABOUT TE CONNECTIVITY

TE Connectivity plc (NYSE: TEL) is a global industrial technology leader creating a safer, sustainable, productive, and connected future. As a trusted innovation partner, our broad range of connectivity and sensor solutions enable the distribution of power, signal and data to advance next-generation transportation, energy networks, automated factories, data centers enabling artificial intelligence, and more.

Our more than 90,000 employees, including 10,000 engineers, work alongside customers in approximately 130 countries. In a world that is racing ahead, TE ensures that EVERY CONNECTION COUNTS. Learn more at and on LinkedIn, Facebook, WeChat,Instagram and X (formerly Twitter).

COMPENSATION
• Competitive base salary commensurate with experience: $155,000 - $210,000 (subject to change dependent on physical location)
• Posted salary ranges are made in good faith. TE Connectivity reserves the right to adjust ranges depending on the experience/qualification of the selected candidate as well as internal and external equity.
• Total Compensation = Base Salary + Incentive(s) + Benefits

BENEFITS
• A comprehensive benefits package including health insurance, 401(k), disability, life insurance, employee stock purchase plan, paid time off and voluntary benefits.

EOE, Including Disability/Vets

TE Connectivity has become aware of fraudulent recruitment activities being conducted by individuals or organizations falsely claiming to represent TE Connectivity. Please be advised that TE Connectivity never requests payment or fees from job applicants at any stage of the recruitment process. All legitimate job openings are posted exclusively on our official careers website at te.com/careers, and all email communications from our recruitment team will come only from actual email addresses ending in @te.com. If you receive any suspicious communications, we strongly advise you not to engage or provide any personal information, and to report the incident to your local authorities.

Couchbase is building the operational data platform for AI. We are hiring a Senior Product Manager, AI to own a defined capability area within the AI portfolio across Capella and Couchbase Enterprise. Reporting to the VP of AI Product Management, this Senior PM partners closely with engineering, sales and GTM, marketing, and the broader AI organization to ship capabilities that solve real problems for our enterprise ICP.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role for someone who wants to do the work at the Senior level — write the PRFAQ, sit with the customer, push the tradeoff, ship the capability, and own the outcome after launch — at the center of one of the most consequential shifts in enterprise data infrastructure. The role is fully remote within the United States, working alongside a distributed product and engineering organization.

What You Will Own

  • Product execution within a defined AI capability area: End-to-end ownership of one or more capabilities inside the AI portfolio. The roadmap in your area, the PRFAQs and PRDs, the launch, the adoption — and the iteration after launch. You contribute to the strategy for the wider portfolio area you sit within, working with the Principal PM and the VP of AI Product Management who set it.

  • Working backwards from the customer: Start with the customer and work backwards. Write the PRFAQ before any code is written. Validate with real, named enterprise customers. Make clear tradeoff calls about what to build and what to defer based on what the enterprise ICP universally needs — not features chasing competitors or one-off requests outside the ICP.

  • Engineering partnership: Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering. Earn their trust by being technically credible, decisive on scope, and clear on the why. Own the PRD as a living document, not a one-time artifact. Hold the bar on quality, scope, and timing through to launch.

  • Customer and design partner engagement: Support and run design partner programs for the capabilities you own. Bring real customer voice into roadmap decisions and back to the broader team. Help build a pipeline of named reference customers willing to talk publicly about what they have shipped.

  • Cross-portfolio collaboration: Coordinate across the broader product organization — Core Database, Capella, Analytics, Mobile and Edge, and the AI Specialist team — so the capabilities you own compose cleanly with the rest of the platform. Bring a build-vs-partner point of view to your area: build where Couchbase is uniquely strong, and surface partnerships and integrations where we can deliver a better customer experience faster.

  • Sales and GTM partnership: Equip sales, sales engineering, PMM, and partner GTM with what they need to win in the capabilities you own — positioning, demos, competitive context, customer proof points. Be the product owner in deals where the technical depth matters.

  • External voice: Contribute as the product owner in customer briefings, webinars, blog posts, documentation, and enablement content for the capabilities you own. Support analyst engagements (Gartner, Forrester, IDC) and keynote content led by the Principal PM, PMM, and AR.

  • AI-driven PM practice: Use AI deeply and visibly in your own product management work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling, engineering collaboration. Adopt and contribute to the team's AI-driven PM and AI-DLC (AI-driven development lifecycle) practices in day-to-day execution.

  • Raising the bar: Share what works. Contribute to PRFAQ and PRD standards, interview loops, and onboarding. Mentor associate and early-career PMs as the team grows.

What You Will Deliver

  • PRFAQs and PRDs for the capabilities you own, validated with named enterprise customers before engineering starts.

  • Shipped capabilities in your area with measurable adoption and at least one named reference customer per major launch.

  • Clear, defensible tradeoff decisions visible to engineering, sales, and GTM. The team knows what is in, what is out, and why.

  • Sales and GTM enablement that the field actually uses — measured by pipeline influence and win-rate signals, not enablement-decks-produced.

  • Contributions to the broader AI portfolio narrative — customer-facing content, blog posts, and documentation in partnership with the AI Specialist team, PMM, and AR.

  • Visible AI-driven PM practice — concrete examples of AI-DLC in your daily work that the rest of the team can learn from.

Must Have

  • Seven or more years in product management, with at least three on a technical platform — database, data infrastructure, developer tools, or AI infrastructure.

  • Technical fluency in modern AI infrastructure: vector search, embeddings, RAG, agent frameworks, model serving, context engineering, and emerging interoperability standards. You can hold your own with engineering on architecture.

  • Customer obsession and working-backwards rigor: You start with the customer and work backwards. You write PRFAQs before code. You can tell which feature requests reflect universal ICP needs and which are noise, and you make the call clearly.

  • Engineering credibility: Engineers want to work with you. You hold your own on architecture, are decisive on scope, and own the why behind every tradeoff.

  • Cross-functional trust: Sales trusts your roadmap. GTM trusts your enablement. Marketing trusts your narrative. You build durable working relationships outside your own team.

  • AI-driven PM practice: You already use AI in your own PM work — research, PRFAQ drafting, customer synthesis, competitive analysis, roadmap modeling — and you can point to concrete examples.

  • Frontier-model experience: Hands-on experience building with frontier AI models — APIs, code-generation tools, MCP, agent frameworks, and modern developer ecosystems. Familiarity with Anthropic's Claude stack is strongly preferred.

  • Strong written communication. Your PRFAQs and PRDs are the artifact the team aligns on, not a chore that follows the work.

  • A shipping record — products and features you have personally taken from PRFAQ to launch to adoption.

Nice to Have

  • Experience at a database, data platform, or AI infrastructure company (MongoDB, Snowflake, Databricks, Elastic, Confluent, Redis, Pinecone, AWS, GCP, Azure, or comparable).

  • Direct experience building or shipping vector search, agent memory, RAG pipelines, model serving, or related AI infrastructure capabilities.

  • Public presence — blog posts, conference talks, OSS contributions, or analyst-facing work.

  • Prior experience mentoring associate or early-career PMs.

Location and Reporting

Remote-US. This role is virtual-first by design — day-to-day execution, including PRFAQs, customer engagement, engineering collaboration, sales partnership, and content development, happens predominantly through virtual channels. Limited travel is required, reserved for high-value moments such as key customer engagements, major industry conferences, team onsites, and periodic visits to Couchbase HQ in Santa Clara. Reports to the VP of AI Product Management.

Base salary is not the only component of our competitive total rewards package - you may also be eligible for bonus, commissions, and other benefits as described below. Actual compensation is influenced by a wide array of factors including but not limited to skill set, level of experience, licenses and certifications, and specific work location.

At Couchbase, we believe innovation thrives when diverse perspectives are at the table.
